in_marathi.name: Ansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sky, Cosmos, Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ansh is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'ansh' meaning 'a particle, a grain'. In Hindu mythology, Ansh is the cosmic egg from which Brahma, the creator, was born. The term 'Ansh' is also used to denote the 'essence' or 'substance' of something. Therefore, Ansh represents the vastness of the universe and the essence of life.
